neighbours.label: the digit '3' right after a leading 1 or 7 in a standard's number (EN 13432, ISO 13485, ISO 7396)
fire: The packaging is certified as compostable under EN 13432.
Our factory is audited every year against ISO 13485.
The helmets were tested to EN 13087 before they went on sale.
All gas outlets on the ward comply with ISO 7396-1.
The driver electronics meet IEC 61347 for lamp control gear.
The first-aid kit in each van follows DIN 13157.
Floor coverings are classified for fire behaviour under EN 13501-1.
The crash barrier on the bridge is rated to EN 1317-2.
quiet: The packaging is certified as food safe under EN 1186.
Our factory is audited every year against ISO 9001.
The helmets were tested to EN 12492 before they went on sale.
All gas outlets on the ward comply with ISO 5359.
The driver electronics meet IEC 60598 for luminaires.
The first-aid kit in each van was restocked in 2013.
Floor coverings were laid in 1350 rooms across the campus.
The crash barrier on the bridge was built in 1937.

notes: Card: '3' 14 of the top 32, in EN/ISO/IEC designations and one phone number; also ' of' and ' ' in SEC-filing phrases ('as of the end of', 'Form 20-F'), which this label does not cover. Probes: EN 13501 1.08, ISO 7396 1.02, DIN 13164 1.00, EN 1317 1.01, +44 1372 0.47; year 1385 0.06, 1300 people 0.01, 4326 0.01 (that is the + pole). Near misses: standards with other digits, and 13 in years and counts.
